cohort: 1,059,600 singleton livebirths born in Sweden in 2001-2012
finding: Cesarean delivery, moderately preterm birth (≥32-36 weeks of gestation), large for gestational age, and low (<7) 5-minute Apgar score were associated with an increased risk of allergic rhinitis in childhood.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a slightly increased risk of allergic rhinitis compared to vaginal delivery.
